error.message: The loop through MIX13, MIX3, PUMP14, KREA4, SCDS5, HTXR6, MIX7, EXTR8, SPLIT9, HTXR19, HTXR10, HTXR18, SCDS15, SCDS11, SPLIT16, HTXR12, HTXR17 did not converge: at iteration 8, Column SCDS15: the mass fraction of Water in the bottoms cannot be 0.9999 in this column with reflux_ratio 2 given: over the whole range of the distillate flow (21.91 to 2169 mol/s, 19 columns solved) it stays between 0.699301 (at 2169) and 0.995438 (at 313). With reflux_ratio fixed at 2, no distillate flow gives it: the reflux ratio is too low for this specification on 18 stages (below the minimum reflux for it), or the stages are too few. What would make it feasible: a larger reflux_ratio (or leave it free: give the distillate or bottoms flow, or a second design specification, in its place), more stages, or a specification within the range above. (on an accelerated guess, broyden, 71 % of the tear flows beyond the last pass's result; the last pass changed the tears by 1.46e-3. Check the specifications and the start values of the loop first; direct substitution, which never extrapolates, shows whether the guess was the cause). What usually helps: a purge or a smaller recycle fraction (a recycle with no way out keeps growing), a guess for the tear streams (S27, S7, S21, S15, S24) close to the answer, another tear stream, another convergence method, or more iterations.
